lines.text: Many learners say: Came my friend yesterday.

native.tip: في العربية نبدأ بالفعل «جاء صديقي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنبدأ بمن قام بالفعل: “My friend came yesterday.” وليس “Came my friend yesterday.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “Came my friend yesterday.” 😅 في العربية نبدأ بالفعل «جاء صديقي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنبدأ بمن قام بالفعل، فالجملة الصحيحة “My friend came yesterday.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you start with the verb?
en.tip: In Arabic we can start with the verb «جاء صديقي», but in English we start with who did it: “My friend came yesterday.” not “Came my friend yesterday.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Came my friend yesterday.” 😅 In Arabic we can start with the verb «جاء صديقي», but in English we start with who did it, so the right sentence is “My friend came yesterday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
